subject: Problems with CJS models in m-array formulation with only one cohort

messages.author: 8aa7b9e8ebc839ba
messages.subject: Problems with CJS models in m-array formulation with only one cohort
parts:
Good morning,

I am trying to implement CJS models in marray formulation but I am using capture-recapture data with individuals ringed only the first year of the study. When I try to construct the marray following the code by Kèry and Schaub 2012 and I run the model (the simplest one, constant effects) the results are wrong. I think the problem is the marray itself. Is it possible that with only one cohort I cannot use marray formulation? I have seven years of recapture.

Any help will be appreciated,

Blanca

messages.author: 8aa7b9e8ebc839ba
messages.subject: Re: Problems with CJS models in m-array formulation with only one cohort
parts: It is solved! Sorry for the simple question, it was a mistake in the code but I was not abe to find it. Thanks!
